body:
## Bug

In `src/patterns/dosdp-patterns/inborn_metabolic_disrupts.yaml`, line 46:

```yaml
def:
  text: An acquired metabolic disease that is has its basis in the disruption of %s.
```

Should be:

```yaml
def:
  text: An inherited metabolic disease that has its basis in the disruption of %s.
```

Two issues:
1. **"acquired" should be "inherited"** — this is a pattern for inborn errors of metabolism, not acquired diseases. Appears to be a copy-paste from `acquired.yaml`.
2. **"is has" should be "has"** — minor grammar typo.

The `equivalentTo` clause correctly references `inborn errors of metabolism` (MONDO:0019052), so the logical definition is fine — only the text template is wrong.

Found during analysis of the "inborn" classification axis in [#9986](https://github.com/monarch-initiative/mondo/issues/9986).
title: Copy-paste error in inborn_metabolic_disrupts.yaml: definition says 'acquired' instead of 'inherited'
